agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has one fast body falling left-down onto the top-right corner of a thin vertical wall (x=[14,14.3], y=[2.8,8.3], top at 8.3). With dt=0.0171 the integrator uses 5-6 substeps per step but still fails to resolve the corner collision. At step 22 body is just outside wall (distance +0.098), at step 23 it first penetrates slightly (-0.051), at step 24 penetration deepens to -0.200 beyond the 0.15 tolerance. No impulse/positional correction pushes it out, so overlap grows monotonically while descending. Halving dt (finer substepping) removes the penetration, indicating insufficient collision resolution / substep count for high-velocity corner impacts at this dt.
